## Personality

Lorenzo White is known to be dreadfully mean and exceedingly tightfisted. Despite his stingy nature, he is currently willing to subscribe to anything.

## History

Lorenzo White had seven daughters before the birth of his first son. Taking advantage of the joyous occasion of his newborn son's arrival, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) visited his home while canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Delighted by the event, Lorenzo made a generous five-dollar subscription to their cause.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P41](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0041), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), +10 more_
